title: a probe's enough threshold declares what set it
intention: a probe's enough threshold declares what set it
what: A probe's 'enough' threshold is set once by whoever wrote the probe and never moves against evidence, so 55 hand-typed numbers across 47 probes decide when the system has learned enough — and the ratified intention that says thresholds move with evidence has no code face at all.
why: A probe's `enough` is the number that decides when the system stops watching and calls a thing settled. 55 of them are typed once by whoever wrote the probe and never move again — so the watches clear on somebody's first guess, and 34 of the 47 files do not even carry a comment saying the number was a guess. The lived symptom is a green that means 'the author picked 3' rather than 'we saw enough'. I-learns-its-gates has been RATIFIED since 2026-07-16 saying thresholds move with evidence, and has no code face at all.
how: MEASURED FIRST, and the measurement reshaped the ticket: 55 numeric `_ENOUGH*` constants across 47 probe files, of which only 13 files carry the comment naming the debt. The other 34 hold identical hand-set numbers with no comment at all — the IOU was declared where somebody happened to remember, not where the debt is, which is exactly why prose cannot be the record. Approach, and it is deliberately NOT 'build the confidence engine': (1) make the threshold DECLARED rather than typed — a probe's `enough` becomes a field on the frozen Probe (`cairn/tools/base/probe.py`) carrying the number AND the ticket or observation that set it, so a threshold with no provenance is refusable; (2) a sieve counts probes whose threshold has no provenance, which turns 34 invisible sites into a number that can go down; (3) ONLY THEN does moving them against evidence become buildable, because you cannot move what you cannot enumerate. Do not build (3) here. The 5000-beat constants and the 1/12 rate in a_pickup_is_witnessed are the interesting cases to read while designing the field — they are not sample sizes at all, and a field shaped only for 'how many observations' will force them to lie.
traces_to: I-learns-its-gates (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-learns-its-gates.md, RATIFIED by Akien 2026-07-16): 'for every gate the system holds a confidence that acting alone is safe, and it moves that confidence with evidence.' A hand-typed constant is a confidence that cannot move. Also Law 4 — the rule is real and enforced by nothing but the author's memory — and Law 3, since 'enough' is a claim about when a measurement is trustworthy and 55 of them are unmeasured.
falsifier: DONE when every probe's `enough` threshold is a declared field carrying its provenance, when a sieve reports the count of provenance-less thresholds, and when that count is 0. HORIZON: the sieve's own reading. WRONG INTENT if this becomes a build of the confidence engine — the engine is I-learns-its-gates' aim and this ticket is the enumeration that has to exist under it; shipping a mover before an enumeration means it moves the 13 that were commented and silently skips the 34 that were not, which is the same defect one layer up.
children: none, because the enumeration is one field on one primitive plus one sieve. The mover that changes thresholds against evidence is NOT a child — it is a separate later ticket under I-learns-its-gates, and calling it a child here would make this ticket unprovable until the engine exists.

watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the provenance-less count, the total probe count, and the count of probes added since the last run
watchme.consumer: whoever builds the confidence engine under I-learns-its-gates — this enumeration is its input
watchme.enough: the count reaches 0 AND holds at 0 across 5 subsequent runs in which at least 2 new probes were added. Holding matters more than reaching: the failure this ticket names is a rule that covers what exists today and lets the 48th probe be born undeclared.
watchme.trigger: each build_inspector run over the corpus — the sieve's own firing

gates_bound.check_type: proofs beside the code, run twice, sealed under the tester with isolation
a red at PROVEME kicks back to this ticket
count probes whose enough threshold carries no provenance; the count must reach 0 over the live corpus
gates_bound.why: this is the physics the IOU owed. A rule that only reaches the 13 sites somebody commented is the prose it replaces, so the gate is the count over ALL 47 files

in: cairn/tools/base/probe.py — the frozen Probe primitive; `enough` gains a value and its provenance while keeping the prose it carries today
the 47 probe files holding 55 numeric _ENOUGH* constants (census by command in the ticket)
cairn/machines/build_inspector/ — the sieve counting provenance-less thresholds
the existing owning_ticket() provenance mechanism, already used by 19 probes — composed, not reinvented
out: THE CONFIDENCE ENGINE — anything that MOVES a threshold against evidence. That is I-learns-its-gates' aim and a separate later ticket. A mover shipped on today's corpus would move the 13 commented sites and silently skip the 34 silent ones, which is this ticket's own defect one layer up.
Sieve bands (0524c3b8b379 KILLED, 16047f83eb88 PROVED) — a different animal: how a sieve reports severity, not when a watch has seen enough.

Computing enough from population size at read time. Rejected on measurement: the 55 are five different kinds of number (count, duration, rate, window, coverage floor) and one rule would be wrong for most of them.

open_for_akien: One, and it is a design detail rather than a spec choice, so my read stands unless you say otherwise: whether `probes_disabled/` is in the corpus the sieve counts. cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes_disabled/reflection_earns_its_ask.py holds _ENOUGH_REFLECTED = 5 in a directory nothing runs. My read: counted but banded separately, because a disabled probe that gets re-enabled carries its undeclared threshold back in with it.
